common.applyFilters: Choose the filters and press Search to run the report.

index.title: Attendance reports
index.intro: Timesheet, overtime, leave and period close reports within your data scope.
index.none: You have not been granted any attendance report.

timesheet-grid.title: Timesheet grid
timesheet-grid.description: Attendance codes per employee × day for a period or a date range (≤ 62 days), with totals per payroll category.

daily-exceptions.title: Daily exceptions
daily-exceptions.description: Late arrivals, early departures, missing punches and absences (≤ 62 days).

punch-log.title: Punch log
punch-log.description: Raw punches by device and employee with source and validation status (audited read).

overtime-summary.title: Overtime summary
overtime-summary.description: Overtime hours of the month and year to date against the caps, per overtime category.

overtime-cap-overrides.title: Overtime cap overrides
overtime-cap-overrides.description: Overtime submitted above the cap with an authorised override: who, why and the cap usage.

leave-balances.title: Leave balances
leave-balances.description: Leave balances as of a date from the ledger: opening, carried in, accrued, taken, adjusted, expired, encashed.

leave-taken.title: Leave taken
leave-taken.description: Approved leave per month × org unit × leave type (≤ 366 days, by start date).

si-leave-register.title: SI-paid leave register
si-leave-register.description: Leave paid by social insurance (sickness, maternity…) with masked claim data (audited read).

period-close-status.title: Period close status
period-close-status.description: Close status per legal entity × pay group with the outstanding checklist items.

retro-adjustments.title: Retro adjustments
retro-adjustments.description: Retro adjustment lines and totals by original period.

filter.periodOrRange: Choose a period or a date range
filter.periodOrRangeRequired: Choose an attendance period or a date range.

ot.capTooltip: Opening {opening} · approved {approved} · pending {pending} · paid {paid} · authorised override {override}

leave.siMaskedNotice: Document numbers show only their last 4 characters; reading this register is audited.

period.waivable: Can be waived at close (with a reason)

inbox.title: Attendance integration inbox
inbox.intro: Events of other modules consumed by Time & Attendance, their processing status and dead letters.
inbox.repairHint: Failed People event: regenerate the employee's schedule. Core locations: use Resync locations.
inbox.resyncHint: Rebuilds the attendance copy of Core's locations (go-live, repair of a dead letter).

jobs.title: Jobs & reminders
jobs.intro: Runs the Time & Attendance nightly job and daily reminders by hand for the whole tenant.

nightly.title: Nightly job
nightly.description: Creates partitions, moves ended periods to review, recalculates timesheets, runs leave accrual / year end and reconciles the close holds.
nightly.confirmText: The job runs for the whole tenant and may take a few minutes. Closed or locked results are not changed.
nightly.doneWithFailures: Nightly job ran for {day}; some steps failed.

reminders.title: Daily reminders
reminders.description: Sends missing-punch reminders (previous day), carried-leave expiry and close-deadline reminders as set per legal entity.
reminders.confirmText: Notifications go to the employees and the close owners concerned.

errors.invalid-range: Invalid date range: give a from and a to date (to on or after from).
errors.range-too-long: The date range is longer than allowed.
